import unittest
from metrics import mean


class TestMean(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test cases for mean function"""
    
    def test_mean_single_value(self):
        """Test mean of a single value"""
        self.assertEqual(mean([5]), 5)
        self.assertEqual(mean([0]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(mean([-10]), -10)
    
    def test_mean_positive_integers(self):
        """Test mean of positive integers"""
        self.assertEqual(mean([1, 2, 3]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(mean([10, 20, 30]), 20)
        self.assertEqual(mean([1, 1, 1]), 1)
    
    def test_mean_negative_integers(self):
        """Test mean of negative integers"""
        self.assertEqual(mean([-1, -2, -3]), -2)
        self.assertEqual(mean([-10, -20, -30]), -20)
    
    def test_mean_mixed_positive_negative(self):
        """Test mean of mixed positive and negative integers"""
        self.assertEqual(mean([-5, 5]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(mean([-10, 0, 10]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(mean([-2, -1, 1, 2]), 0)
    
    def test_mean_floats(self):
        """Test mean of float values"""
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mean([1.5, 2.5, 3.5]), 2.5)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mean([0.1, 0.2, 0.3]), 0.2)
    
    def test_mean_mixed_int_float(self):
        """Test mean of mixed integers and floats"""
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mean([1, 2.5, 4]), 2.5)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mean([1.0, 2, 3.0]), 2.0)
    
    def test_mean_large_numbers(self):
        """Test mean of large numbers"""
        self.assertEqual(mean([1000000, 2000000, 3000000]), 2000000)
    
    def test_mean_many_values(self):
        """Test mean of many values"""
        values = list(range(1, 101))  # 1 to 100
        self.assertEqual(mean(values), 50.5)
    
    def test_mean_empty_list_raises_error(self):
        """Test that mean of empty list raises ValueError"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            mean([])
        self.assertEqual(str(context.exception), "no values")
    
    def test_mean_returns_float(self):
        """Test that mean returns a float"""
        result = mean([1, 2, 3])
        self.assertIsInstance(result, float)
    
    def test_mean_zero_values(self):
        """Test mean of zero values"""
        self.assertEqual(mean([0, 0, 0]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(mean([0]), 0)
    
    def test_mean_very_small_floats(self):
        """Test mean of very small float values"""
        self.assertAlmostEqual(mean([0.001, 0.002, 0.003]), 0.002)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
